system.description:
Secret (a sealed flask of dragon blood). Drink it; no study or check.

  • You gain Resistance 10 against that dragon's breath damage type for good.
  • Once per character; the flask is used up.
  • Dragon blood paid as tribute in the days of Tiahane's empire.
  • Drinking it marks you as hers, and her kin can smell it.

Monsters & Treasure, Secrets: one of a kind, never sold, placed by the GM. Study it in downtime (Study a Secret); no one can teach it.
